標 is a mark that shows where to look or what to aim for. [標本](../words/標本.md) ひょうほん is a specimen or sample, [標準](../words/標準.md) ひょうじゅん is a standard or norm, [標識](../words/標識.md) ひょうしき is a sign or marker and [目標](../words/目標.md) もくひょう is a goal or target.

- [印](印.md), "stamp; mark," [符](符.md), "token; sign; charm," [示](示.md), "indicate," [的](的.md), "target; adjectival suffix," [当](当.md), "hit; be on target," [準](準.md), "standard, conform," [規](規.md), "standard; rule," [導](導.md), "guide; conduct," and [栞](栞.md), "bookmark; guidebook," overlap the senses "mark," "sign," "target," "standard" and "guide" that 標 and its words carry. They are kept out of this card's quiz options. Do not treat "mark" or "sign" as exclusive to any one character.
quiz_exclusions: [史, 記, 誌, 録, 歴, 書, 籍, 述, 規, 律, 則, 典, 法, 制, 憲, 整, 順, 年, 期, 代, 世, 齢, 著, 歳, 筆, 文, 字, 時, 刻, 準]

紀 is associated with a chronicle or account. Digital Daijisen also gives a standalone rules/code-of-conduct sense, ordered recording, recorded history, years/ages, a twelve-year period, and a geological-period use. The rules sense appears in words such as 綱紀 and 風紀; this is broader than JMdict's rare spelling 紀律 for 規律. In [世紀](../words/世紀.md) (せいき), the whole compound means a century or, more broadly, an era. The hundred-year unit belongs to 世紀, not to 紀 by itself.

- [筆](筆.md) and [文](文.md) overlap with writing or written composition. [字](字.md) is guarded for its broader dictionary sense "written text," not because a single written symbol is a chronicle. [準](準.md) is guarded at the standard/rule boundary. [時](時.md) and [刻](刻.md) have broad "time" labels, guarded conservatively against 紀's chronological senses; this does not make 紀 a word for an hour or a clock time.

The Daijisen character entry gives three senses for キョウ. The first is an instrument for seeing one's own reflection, as in 鏡台 きょうだい, "dresser; dressing table; vanity table," 鏡面 きょうめん, "mirror surface; lens surface," and 明鏡 めいきょう, "polished mirror; clear mirror." The second is an instrument that uses lenses, as in 眼鏡 がんきょう, "glasses; eyeglasses; spectacles," 顕微鏡 and 望遠鏡, and the third is a model to learn from, as in 鏡鑑 きょうかん, "paragon; mirror."

- [映](映.md), "reflect, project," [照](照.md), "illuminate; shine," [像](像.md), "image; statue," [例](例.md), "example; precedent," and [則](則.md), "rule; follow a model," overlap the ideas of reflecting light, showing an image and serving as a model that 鏡 and its words involve. They are kept out of this card's quiz options. Do not treat "mirror" as exclusive to any one character.
２ 区切られた枠。「範囲・範疇(はんちゅう)」

[範](../kanji/範.md) contributes a model, standard, or bounds, and [囲](../kanji/囲.md) contributes enclosing or surrounding. Together they name a bounded extent. This component association is a memory aid, not an account of the word's historical formation. The on readings are ハン + イ.
quiz_exclusions: [型, 例, 規, 則, 法, 典, 式, 幅, 準, 律, 憲, 域, 般, 類, 師, 象, 儀, 制, 程, 令]

- [域](域.md) concerns a region or range, [程](程.md) a degree or extent, and [般](般.md) includes scope or category. [類](類.md) groups things by kind; 範疇 はんちゅう also names a category. Each comparison is with a bounded sense, not a claim that the words are freely interchangeable.
域 concerns an area, region, range or limit. 地域 ちいき is an area or region; [区域](../words/区域.md) くいき is a designated area or zone.

- [師](師.md) includes a model or exemplar in the character dictionary; [象](象.md) can mean modeling on something, and [儀](儀.md) appears in 地球儀, a globe or model of Earth. A teacher, an act of representation, and a globe are not automatically a standard to follow.

師 points to a teacher, master, or practitioner with a particular skill.
Compare [教師](../words/教師.md) きょうし, a teacher, with 医師 いし, a physician.
These name different professions; the shared character does not mean that every specialist teaches a class.
範 can mean a model or standard. In [範囲](../words/範囲.md) はんい it occurs in a word for a range or scope; that word's meaning is not simply "model."

comparisons.reason: JMdict 格 has a rule/regulation/law and method sense; card gives 合格 "meeting a standard" (repo/kanji/格.md:3-38)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless on supplied evidence: neither title is a defensible answer for the other; JMdict rule sense is not "model; standard". A Daijisen standard sense for 格 is asserted only on 憲 card (repo/kanji/憲.md:1-146) and is UNVERIFIED; optional guard O4. Pair undeclared on both endpoints.

comparisons.reason: 標 card states 標 and its words carry "standard" and excludes 準 and 規 for it (repo/kanji/標.md:14; repo/kanji/標.md:54)
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion: 範 displays "standard" and KANJIDIC2 "example/model" overlaps 標本 sample/example (repo/kanji/標.md:23). Pair undeclared on either endpoint. F1.

comparisons.reason: "standard" only via 基準; 基 card's Daijisen senses are foundation/ground (repo/kanji/基.md:23-25)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: no character-level model/standard sense; 基 itself does not guard 準/規. Pair undeclared; not required.

comparisons.reason: 倣う "follow a model" (repo/kanji/倣.md:3-25) vs English verb "model"
comparisons.disposition: Harmless with medium confidence: displayed "model; standard" pairs model with a noun, while 範 evidence is the exemplar (1956840, 範を垂れる); the act of copying stays distinguishable. Undeclared; optional guard O4.

comparisons.reason: 鏡 card gives Daijisen third sense "a model to learn from" (鏡鑑) and excludes 例 and 則 for serving as a model (repo/kanji/鏡.md:25; repo/kanji/鏡.md:54)
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion: "model; standard" is a closer match to that sense than 例 or 則. Pair undeclared on either endpoint. F2.

comparisons.reason: 手本 "model" appears only as a word on 本 (repo/kanji/本.md:28)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: card gives no character-level model sense; origin/book is not a defensible answer for 範. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: かた form/style; JMdict 形 entries lack "model" (repo/kanji/形.md:3-25)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: shape/form is not a model or standard on supplied evidence; 型 (mold; type, model sense) is already excluded. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: statue/likeness vs model (repo/kanji/像.md:3-20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: card gives image/statue/imagination only, no exemplar sense. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 範 Daijisen sense 2 区切られた枠 (範囲・範疇) (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:20); 限 sets a boundary (repo/kanji/限.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion (low): 範 already guards 域 region/range/limit and 程 extent for the bounds sense; "limit" is at least as close. Undeclared. F3.

comparisons.reason: boundary or limit sense (repo/kanji/界.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless with low confidence: primary displayed sense "world" is not defensible for 範; the secondary "boundary" overlap is weaker than 限/境. Undeclared; noted in F3 evidence as borderline.

comparisons.reason: boundary, border or region (repo/kanji/境.md:20) vs 区切られた枠
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion (low), same reasoning as 限 and the existing 域 guard. Undeclared. F3.

comparisons.reason: partner in 範囲; 囲 card says 範囲 extends enclosing to range (repo/kanji/囲.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: the action "surround; enclose" is 囲's contribution, not a defensible meaning for 範, and 範 is not an act of enclosing. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: Daijisen 範 sense 3 広く行き渡る, only example 広範 (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:21)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless with low confidence: the 範 card does not teach that sense and its only cited compound is 広範; optional guard O4. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 広範 "wide; extensive" (repo/kanji/広.md:3-22)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: in 広範 the width idea is supplied by 広; "wide, spacious" is not defensible for 範. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: degree/measure vs standard (repo/kanji/度.md:3-20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless on supplied evidence: card teaches degree and occurrences only; a rule sense is asserted only by 憲 card and is UNVERIFIED. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: JMdict のり "transverse measurement" applies to all spellings including 範 (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:124-671)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: that sense belongs to the obscure word のり, not taught on 範; "measure; plan" is not a defensible meaning for 範. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: measuring/gauging (repo/kanji/測.md:20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless for the same reason as 計. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 紀 card gives a Daijisen rules/code-of-conduct sense and guards 規 律 則 典 法 制 憲 and 準 "at the standard/rule boundary" (repo/kanji/紀.md:14; repo/kanji/紀.md:23; repo/kanji/紀.md:48)
comparisons.disposition: Collision needing exclusion: 範 "model; standard" sits exactly on that standard/rule boundary, and 範 itself guards the same set. Undeclared on either endpoint. F1.

comparisons.reason: 監 guards 規 則 律 典 準 法 儀 only for loose English "rule" and says 監 does not mean a measuring standard (repo/kanji/監.md:1-176)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 範's displayed title has no "rule" and 監 has no model/standard sense. Undeclared; not required.

comparisons.reason: English "standard" can mean usual (repo/kanji/常.md:3-22)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: "model; standard" pairs standard with a noun, and 範 evidence has no usual/ordinary sense. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 模様 "pattern" on 様 card vs KANJIDIC2 範 "pattern" (repo/kanji/様.md:28-38)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: displayed manner/honorific is not defensible for 範, and 様's pattern is word-level. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 准 card notes 準 has related meanings (repo/kanji/准.md:20-45)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 准 is taught as associate rank/ratification, with no standard or model sense. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: method vs law/model parallel (repo/kanji/方.md:3-20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: no model/standard sense on supplied evidence. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: category via 範疇 vs kind (repo/kanji/種.md:3-22)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 範 alone does not mean kind; 範疇 is a whole-word meaning, and Daijisen sense 2 is a delimited frame, not a kind. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: standard level vs average (repo/kanji/均.md:3-20)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: card teaches levelling/averaging only. Undeclared.

comparisons.reason: 範 note says 般 includes scope or category (snapshot/kanji/範.md:45)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: 般 card body names kinds, scope or generality (repo/kanji/般.md:20); direct pair declared on 範 (snapshot/kanji/範.md:14), not on 般.

comparisons.reason: 範 note says 師 includes model or exemplar in the character dictionary (snapshot/kanji/範.md:46)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled as a conservative guard (declared on 範, not on 師). 師 card has no exemplar sense (repo/kanji/師.md:20-22); JMdict 師範 sense 2 supports it at word level only; the character-dictionary claim is UNVERIFIED (O2).

comparisons.reason: direct shared head word "standard" (repo/kanji/規.md:3)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: genuine collision, declared on 範 only.

comparisons.reason: 範 note says law/rule overlap (snapshot/kanji/範.md:44)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: 憲 has broader rule/law meaning (repo/kanji/憲.md:20-25); declared on 範, not on 憲.

comparisons.reason: 地球儀 model of Earth; JMdict 儀範 precedent/model (repo/kanji/儀.md:50-51)

comparisons.reason: direct "standard" and conformity to a model (repo/kanji/準.md:20)
